auto_fix.title: Check 36's raw-read regex misses two formatting evasion classes — a future raw br --json read ships uncaught
auto_fix.fix: Scan the JOINED text, not per-line lines: strip backslash-newline continuations (`text.replace('\\\n', ' ')`) before matching, and harden the binary token to allow quotes around it (add `["']?\bbr\b["']?`). Add both evasion shapes as fixture cases in 36-br-envelope.test.sh so the sensor is mutation-tested against them.

auto_fix.title: Check 36 blind to a raw br --json read split across lines — green tree with an unenrouted call site

Add both rows to 35-board-integrity.test.sh.
